title: Winter weather: Car crashes into tow driver in front of police
description:
The incident occurred on Sunday, January 24, 2022. Per the tow truck driver's report on social media, he was released from the hospital the same day. The video indicates, that by miracle or good luck, he is thankfull to be able to walk away from this incident.  

Please consider sharing this video to encourage safe cold-weather driving and promote "move over" awareness for roadside helpers. 

MN Safety reached out to the tow company in question to confirm elements of this story. 

MN Safety is the first to publish real life videos to help identify risk and promote traffic safety awareness. Should you ever have any concerns about our videos or want to share your experience as a crash survivor, please email us anytime at mn.safety.alerts@gmail.com
